title: How are Speech Therapy goals set for a child with Autism?
metaTitle: Speech Therapy Goal Setting for Children with Autism | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understanding how Pinnacle Blooms Network sets personalized Speech Therapy goals for children with Autism based on comprehensive assessments and parent insights.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we deeply understand that each child is unique, and hence, their goals should be too. Our skilled therapists initiate the therapy process with a comprehensive assessment of a child's current communication skills. This, coupled with valuable insights from parents, enables us to carefully craft personalized short-term and long-term goals. Our goals are designed to challenge the child, yet be achievable, to ensure steady progress. We consistently review and update these objectives to ensure that they align with the child's evolving competencies.
